title: Food & Nutrition
description: Grade 3 Science: food and nutrition — why we eat, energy-giving, body-building and protective foods, and a balanced diet. Sort foods and build a healthy plate.

topics.title: Why We Eat Food
topics.concept:
We eat food because our body needs it to live and grow. Food does three big jobs:

  • ⚡ Gives us energy to run, play, think and work.
  • 💪 Helps our body grow and repair itself.
  • 🛡️ Keeps us healthy and fights illness.

The good things in food that help our body are called nutrients. Different foods have different nutrients, so we must eat many kinds of food.

recap: We eat food for energy, to grow, and to stay healthy.
The helpful parts of food are called nutrients.

wonder.text: After a busy day of play you feel tired and hungry. What does food actually do inside your body?

qa.a: Nutrients are the helpful parts inside food that our body uses to get energy, grow and stay healthy. No single food has them all, so we eat a variety.
Hunger is your body's clever way of saying it has used up its energy and needs more food. Eating fills you up and gives you fresh energy again.

topics.title: Energy-Giving Foods
topics.concept:
Energy-giving foods are like fuel for our body. They give us the energy to move and play.

  • 🍚 Grains — rice, wheat (roti, bread), oats.
  • 🥔 Starchy foods — potato.
  • 🍌 Some fruits like banana.
  • 🧈 Fats — ghee, butter and oil give lots of energy too (eat only a little).
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="320" height="150" fill="#fff7ea"/><text x="53.333333333333336" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍚</text><text x="53.333333333333336" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Rice</text><text x="160" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍞</text><text x="160" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Bread</text><text x="266.6666666666667" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥔</text><text x="266.6666666666667" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Potato</text><text x="160" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Energy-giving foods</text></svg>
recap: Energy-giving foods are the body's fuel.
Grains (rice, wheat), potatoes and bananas give energy.
Fats give lots of energy — eat only a little.

wonder.text: Before a big race, an athlete eats a plate of rice or pasta. Why these foods?

qa.q: Why eat rice or roti before sports?
qa.a: Grains like rice and wheat are packed with energy. Eating them gives your muscles fuel, so you can run, jump and play for longer.
A little fat is good — it gives energy and keeps us warm. But too much oily, fried food is not healthy. So we eat fats only in small amounts.

topics.title: Body-Building Foods
topics.concept:
Body-building foods help us grow tall and strong, and repair our body when it is hurt. They are rich in a nutrient called protein.

  • 🥛 Milk and milk foods like paneer and curd.
  • 🥚 Eggs
  • 🫘 Dal, beans and pulses.
  • 🐟 Fish, chicken and meat.
  • 🥜 Nuts like peanuts and almonds.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="320" height="150" fill="#fff0f0"/><text x="53.333333333333336" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥛</text><text x="53.333333333333336" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Milk</text><text x="160" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥚</text><text x="160" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Egg</text><text x="266.6666666666667" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🫘</text><text x="266.6666666666667" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Dal</text><text x="160" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Body-building foods</text></svg>
recap: Body-building foods help us grow and repair our body.
Milk, eggs, dal, fish and nuts are body-building foods.

wonder.text: You grow taller every year. Which foods help build your growing body?

qa.a: Protein is a special nutrient that builds and repairs our body — our muscles, skin, hair and more. Foods like milk, eggs and dal are full of it.
Yes! Dal, beans, milk, paneer, curd and nuts are all full of protein. A vegetarian can grow big and strong without eating meat.

topics.title: Protective Foods
topics.concept:
Protective foods keep us healthy and protect us from illness. They are full of vitamins and minerals.

  • 🥬 Vegetables — spinach, carrot, tomato.
  • 🍎 Fruits — orange, apple, mango, guava.
  • These help our eyes, skin, bones and teeth stay strong, and fight off germs.

💧 Water is special too — it is not a food, but our body needs lots of it every day.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="330" height="150" fill="#eefff0"/><text x="55" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🍎</text><text x="55" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Fruit</text><text x="165" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥦</text><text x="165" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Veg</text><text x="275" y="64" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle">🥕</text><text x="275" y="110" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#23314f" text-anchor="middle">Carrot</text><text x="165" y="138" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#555" text-anchor="middle">Protective foods (vitamins)</text></svg>
recap: Protective foods keep us healthy and fight illness.
Fruits and vegetables are full of vitamins and minerals.
Drink plenty of water every day.

wonder.text: Why does everyone say 'eat your fruits and vegetables'? What do they protect you from?

qa.a: Vitamins are tiny helpers in food that keep different parts of us healthy — like vitamin A in carrots for our eyes, and vitamin C in oranges to fight colds.
Water keeps our body cool, helps food move through us, and carries away waste. More than half of you is water, so you must keep topping it up!

topics.title: A Balanced Plate
topics.concept:
No single food has everything our body needs. A balanced diet means eating some food from EACH group every day:

  • ⚡ Energy foods (rice, roti) — for fuel.
  • 💪 Body-building foods (dal, milk, egg) — to grow.
  • 🛡️ Protective foods (fruits, vegetables) — to stay healthy.
  • 💧 Plenty of water.

A colourful plate with a little of everything keeps us strong, active and well. Sweets and fried snacks are 'sometimes' treats — only a little!
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 220 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="220" height="200" fill="#fffdf5"/><circle cx="110" cy="95" r="78" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d9cdb8" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M110 95 L110 17 A78 78 0 0 1 188 95 Z" fill="#ffe1a8"/><path d="M110 95 L188 95 A78 78 0 0 1 110 173 Z" fill="#ffd0d0"/><path d="M110 95 L110 173 A78 78 0 0 1 32 95 Z" fill="#d8f0d0"/><path d="M110 95 L32 95 A78 78 0 0 1 110 17 Z" fill="#fff3c4"/><text x="146" y="58" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#a67c00" text-anchor="middle">Grains</text><text x="150" y="120" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#b24a4a" text-anchor="middle">Protein</text><text x="74" y="130" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#3f7a2f" text-anchor="middle">Veg</text><text x="72" y="64" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#a67c00" text-anchor="middle">Fruit</text><text x="110" y="196" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#7a5b1a" text-anchor="middle">A balanced plate</text></svg>
recap: No one food has everything — we need a balanced diet.
Eat some energy, body-building and protective food each day.
Drink water; have sweets and fried snacks only sometimes.

wonder.text: Is it healthy to eat only rice every day, even if you eat a LOT of it? Why not?

qa.a: A balanced diet has a little of every food group — energy, body-building and protective foods, plus water. It gives the body all the nutrients it needs.
A treat now and then is okay, but sweets and fried chips have little goodness and too much can harm our teeth and health. Eat them only sometimes.

questions.explanation: Food gives us energy, helps us grow and keeps us healthy.
Grains like rice are energy-giving foods.
Eggs are rich in protein, which builds our body.
Fruits and vegetables are protective foods full of vitamins and minerals.
A balanced diet has a little from each food group.

questions.q: Which should we have only SOMETIMES?
questions.explanation: Sweets and chips are treats to have only sometimes.

questions.q: Why is it unhealthy to eat ONLY rice every day?
options: No single food has all the nutrients the body needs
questions.explanation: No one food has everything — we need a balanced diet from all groups.

questions.q: A vegetarian can get body-building protein from…
questions.explanation: Dal, milk, paneer and nuts are protein-rich body-building foods.
Carrots have vitamin A, which keeps our eyes healthy.

questions.q: Why must we drink lots of water?
options: It keeps the body cool, moves food and removes waste
questions.explanation: Water keeps us cool, helps digestion and carries away waste.

questions.q: Which plate is the MOST balanced?
options: Rice, dal, vegetables and a fruit
questions.explanation: Rice (energy), dal (body-building), vegetables and fruit (protective) make a balanced plate.
